units.text: Article 1 of the 1969 Vienna Convention states the present Convention applies to treaties between States, not private corporations. Source 32e9192a confirms scope is limited to States.

citations.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (1969)

judgement.reason: The passage states Article 1: 'The present Convention applies to treaties between States,' which directly supports that its scope is limited to States and thus not to private corporations.

units.text: Article 3 explicitly states the Convention does not apply to agreements between States and other subjects of international law, reinforcing that private corporations are outside its scope. Source 6af12665 cites Articles 1 and 3.

citations.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (1969)

judgement.reason: The passages quote Article 3 stating the Convention does not apply to agreements between States and other subjects of international law, and include Articles 1 and 3, but neither passage mentions private corporations.

units.text: The Convention was done at Vienna in 1969; Article 1 restricts applicability to State-to-State treaties, contradicting applicability to private corporations. Source 10b8b0ba cites the opening clause and Article 1.

citations.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (1969)

judgement.reason: The passages confirm the Convention was done at Vienna in 1969 and Article 1 applies to treaties between States (thus excluding private corporations), but they do not establish that source 10b8b0fa cites these provisions.
